summary: Definium Therapeutics (filer) filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 20,588,236 common shares at $34.00 per share, plus a 30-day over-allotment option for 3,088,235 shares exercised in full, expected to close June 25, 2026. Gross proceeds ~$805M, net ~$758M, used for R&D, potential commercialization of DT120 ODT, and working capital. Underwriters include J.P. Morgan, Jefferies, Leerink, BofA. This is a standard equity financing, not a special situation.
